privateCampaignNote: This is a private campaign. Donations to it are not reflected in your profile statistics.

claim.feeNote: Harmony does not charge for using the platform. Transactions on the TON network require gas — about {{fee}} GRAM. Please make sure your wallet holds that amount.
claim.channelReportNote: After withdrawal, you can upload an expense report. Approval gives +10 to Trust Score. No penalties for missing or rejected reports for channel campaigns.
claim.publicReportNote: After withdrawal, you have 14 days to upload an expense report. Approval gives +10 to Trust Score. Missing report reduces Trust Score by 10, rejected report reduces it by 7.

refusal.not_deployed: The campaign is not on chain yet — nothing to claim
refusal.already_claimed: The funds have already been claimed
refusal.campaign_frozen: The campaign is frozen — claiming is unavailable
refusal.campaign_refunded: The funds have been returned to the donors
refusal.nothing_raised: Nothing was raised — there is nothing to claim
refusal.fundraising_in_progress: Fundraising is still running. You can claim what was raised once the deadline passes, even if the goal is not met
refusal.insufficient_balance: The contract is short of GRAM for the payout — please contact support

refund.connectWallet: Connect wallet to get a refund
refund.otherWallet: This wallet has not donated to this campaign. Connect the one you donated from.
refund.feeNote: The campaign is frozen and you can take your donation back. Harmony charges nothing for this, but a TON transaction requires gas — about {{fee}} GRAM. Please make sure your wallet holds that amount.

expense.title: Expense report
expense.channelHint: You can upload an expense report. Approval gives +10 to your rating.
expense.personalHint: Upload an expense report. Approval gives +10 to your rating, missing report may lower your rating.
expense.personalHintNoPenalty: You can upload an expense report. Approval gives +10 to your rating; there is no penalty for skipping it on this campaign.
expense.uploadInstructions: Upload photos of receipts or other documents confirming fund usage (up to 5 photos).

donate.gramOnlyNote: The campaign's wallet is the Money wallet in Telegram — USDT transfers are not possible.
donate.title: Donation
donate.notDeployed: Campaign is not yet deployed on blockchain. Try again later.
donate.noUsdt: You don't have USDT in your wallet. Choose GRAM to donate.
donate.usdtUnavailable: USDT is not yet available on testnet. Choose GRAM.
donate.timeoutError: No blockchain confirmation detected. If your wallet still shows the transaction as pending, wait for the result before retrying.
donate.successConfirmed: Donation confirmed and added to the campaign
donate.successConfirmedUsd: Donation confirmed and added to the campaign ≈ ${{amount}}
donate.pendingDescription: Wallet accepted the request. Don't close the wallet until the transaction completes. Campaign will update after network confirmation.
